user.title: Add GrubStation Host
user.description: Enter the host and port of the remote machine running the GrubStation daemon.

pin.title: Authenticate with GrubStation
pin.description: Enter the PIN code of your GrubStation daemon and a Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token so the daemon can report back to HA.

interface.title: Configure Network Interface
interface.description: Select the physical network interface that GrubStation should use for boot management communications.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GrubStation daemon.
error.no_physical_interfaces: No physical network interfaces were found on the remote machine.

abort.already_configured: This host or network interface is already configured.
